title: Ensure ECS Exec sessions have audit logging enabled

initial_audit.check: Ensure ECS Exec sessions have audit logging enabled
initial_audit.details: ECS Cluster 'cis-compute-benchmark-cluster' có executeCommandConfiguration.logging = NONE_OR_DEFAULT (chưa đặt thành OVERRIDE với CloudWatch/S3 log destination chuyên biệt).

remediation_actions.details: Đã cấu hình logging='OVERRIDE' (CloudWatch Log Group: /ecs/exec-audit-logs) cho ECS Cluster 'cis-compute-benchmark-cluster'.

post_remediation_audit.check: Ensure ECS Exec sessions have audit logging enabled
post_remediation_audit.details: ECS Cluster 'cis-compute-benchmark-cluster' đã cấu hình ECS Exec audit logging = OVERRIDE (Destination: /ecs/exec-audit-logs, Exec-enabled services: 0).
